universe: Frozen date-specific certified ranked, seed-eligible and dated ordinary-share tax-verified stocks with 21 valid daily closes; original ranks 1..10 only, never backfill. Every arm uses the same pool per model/date.
cross: SMA5/20 previous <= and current >; official closes for EOD, prior daily closes plus original observed price for LIVE. No near/confirmed/already-above.
crossPriority: ascending ticker independent of model; cap 10. BOTH intersects original TOP10 with ALL entrants before cap.
layers: Reconstructed available after signal close by assumption; verified publications at first confirmed regular open strictly after receipt; LIVE only with full contemporary ranked universe and transition input. Never pool layers.
portfolio: KRW 100000000; ten concurrent slots; target previous closing NAV/10 each; integer units capped by remaining cash. Buy at open before close exits, no duplicate or extension, exit at fifth session close including entry. No leverage/stops. Only dates whose scheduled exit is on or before dataThrough; same entry date collision uses most recent known signal.
pricePolicy: Official executable opens/closes. Untradable open: skip; missing held mark/exit: block account, no favorable fills. Gross cash yield 0. Daily bars cannot verify queue fills. No dividend/split-adjusted total-return claims.
benchmark: Each actual funded trade notional times matched official market open-to-close index return; unused capital in cash. Incomplete coverage => no aggregate excess.
primaryMetric: Net terminal NAV return, with max daily NAV drawdown, exposure, cash, net trade distribution, distinct entry signals/stocks and largest absolute P&L ticker and exit-date shares. No annualization or model promotion.
evaluation: Previously inspected period; descriptive only. Preserve separate D challenger 60-new-signal-day and mature H5 gate.
